diagnosis: The OpenTelemetry trace inspection endpoint queries the distributed trace store (Tempo/Jaeger) directly using the client-provided traceId. Although the requesting user is authenticated as a developer, the handler performs no validation to check if the spans in the trace contain tenant_id or service attributes belonging to the user's assigned organization. Because spans routinely record database queries, HTTP headers, authentication tokens, and user PII, an attacker can extract sensitive operational and customer data from rival tenants.
